title: Quite Enhanced Vanilla
description: Quite Enhanced Vanilla is a modpack designed to enhance performance and rejuvenate the excitement of Minecraft while preserving its classic vanilla feel.
body: **Quite Enhanced Vanilla** is a Minecraft modpack that **adds new biomes** and **optimizations** to make the game more exciting while staying true to the **vanilla experience**. It **enhances performance** and introduces fresh content, giving players a more dynamic world to explore without losing the charm of the original game.
